passage:
In computer class, students searched their own names online. Some found photos, game profiles, old comments, and school event pages.
One student found an angry comment he had written two years earlier. He had forgotten it, but the internet had not.
The teacher explained digital footprints. Online actions can remain long after feelings change.
The class discussed privacy settings, respectful posting, and asking before sharing photos of others.
Students did not leave the class afraid of the internet. They left more aware.
A footprint in sand disappears with waves. A digital footprint may stay until someone finds it. Walking online requires care.
